profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, Cloud Platform at Mapbox with AWS and GraphQL expertise.
profile.jobTitle: Senior Software Engineer II - Developer Experience
profile.summary: As a Software Developer III on the cloud platform team at World Fuel Services, I enable faster and more efficient development and deployment of cloud-native applications. I use AWS, GraphQL, and Typescript to design and implement APIs, templates, and automations that serve various business domains.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer II - Developer Experience
Technical Consultant
positions.description:
1. Set up a production ready AWS organization with  SSO, Client VPN, and segregated accounts (Test, Staging, Production, Shared). Each account having public and private subnets, multi-AZ , and vpn access.

2. Created a CICD pipelines pattern for spring boot micro services using AWS ECS Fargate + AWS LoadBalancer + CloudFlare (public dns) + AWS CDk. If communicating to a PostgreSQL database the CICD pipelines included a step for Flyway database migrations. 

3. Wrote a cicd pipeline for Angular SPA on an AWS S3 bucket served + proxied by CloudFlare, provisioned by AWS CDK.

4. Provide on going support for cloud infrastructure like provisioning of elasticache clusters to support websocket connections.

positions.title: Software Developer III - Cloud Platform
positions.description:
1. Implemented Drift Detection and Resolution to keep 4000 child repos in sync with 10+ templates via a GraphQL API (Typescript, Apollo, Node) and a Bitbucket Pipe (docker, typescript, node).

2. Designed and implemented a multi-account multi-region variable management API for our developer portal using Typescript, GraphQL, Apollo Server, and ECS.

3. Designed and implemented a GraphQL API responsible for creating records and querying our internal and external DNS solutions. I also developed the custom resource consumers packaged in Service Catalog Products.

4. Created and maintained software templates (src code, CI/CD as code, config as code) for Java Springboot, Dotnet, and Typescript NodeJs (rest and GraphQL).

5. Designed and developer an asset graph that ensures when a repository is created, the required company assets are automatically created and configured. This is triggered via Webhooks.

6. Developed a CDK Deployment Pattern for Angular UI's.

7. Designed and implemented a developer experience client library in typescript for ensuring uniform use of devtools across a suite of 20+ GraphQL API's.

8. Developed Atlassian Forge Applications in React.

9. Spotify Backstage Developer.
positions.insights: Service Catalog, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +14 skills

positions.title: Software Developer I
positions.description:
1. Enabled Log4j security remediation and progress tracking by creating a CLI tool that scanned 3000 repositories for indications of Log4j in the dependency tree.

2. Designed and implemented a platform uplift of Oracle Weblogic java applications using Docker + ECS Fargate.

3. Created AWS Service Catalog Products (self-service infra) to automate the provisioning of container, serverless, and messaging infrastructure with AWS CloudFormation.

4. Developed docker-based deployment automations for container and serverless applications using Python.

5. Demonstrated operational excellence in SRE functions for 300+ cloud-native applications.
positions.insights: Amazon Web Services (AWS), CDK and +5 skills
